errors.description: Sign typo in the lower-inequality expansion: (t+2c+y)^2-4(t+c)(y+b) actually equals (t-y)^2+4(t+c)(c-b), not 4(t+c)(b-c). The stated conclusion (5), b-c ≤ (t-y)^2/(4(t+c)), is nevertheless the correct consequence of the correct expansion, so the argument is unaffected.

parsed.notes: Clean, complete proof: x=f(y) gives f(f(y))=2f(y)-y, positivity forces d≥0, substitution x=f(t) yields the quadratic Lipschitz-type bound |d(y)-d(t)|≤(y-t)^2/(4min), and a telescoping partition forces d constant. Converse verified. Only a harmless intermediate sign typo.
